selection_rules.exact: An exact candidate must first identify the catalog theorem and preserve its complete domains, binders, curve family, hypotheses, conclusion, and boundary cases, or provide an independently checked transport to that frozen proposition.
selection_rules.supporting: Weierstrass object models, discriminants, two-torsion polynomials, affine group laws, abstract proposition packages, and projection wrappers are supporting material only.
selection_rules.placeholder: A bodyless, sorry-bearing, unsafe, oracle-backed, or otherwise untrusted candidate is M5 for root credit.
selection_rules.unresolved_target: While the source identity is unresolved, no topic-similar theorem may receive exact-root or transport credit; identified interfaces are classified M2, abstract statement shapes M3, no-artifact results M4, and incompatible substitutions M5 as applicable.
selection_rules.negative_evidence: Each lane records its query or source, immutable revision or content hash, observation boundary, and reopen condition. Access failure and bounded search are not global absence proofs.
selection_rules.deduplication: Aliases, wrappers, statement shapes, and candidates sharing one terminal body count once for proof credit.

credentials_policy: No credentials or moving-ref network queries are admitted by this worker inventory.
network_policy: denied for replay; use repository-tracked observations and the existing clean manifest-pinned package closure read-only; do not clone, fetch, update, or build dependencies
negative_result_evidence: Every negative lane is content-bound through discovery-evidence.json and names its access boundary and reopen condition.
immutable_refresh_policy: A source-identity resolution, changed pin, new immutable candidate, changed query evidence, or policy change creates a new append-only inventory version.
